name: Extraordinary Materials
label: Quest
description: Extraordinary Materials: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Vargus, Cenarion Hold's blacksmith, has requested enchanted materials to be used in the crafting of powerful weapons for our forces. Obtain these and bring them directly to Vargus so that Cenarion Hold's troops may continue to be well equipped.
